name: Visages
source:
Dystopian Futuristic Novel loosely based on Aldous Huxley's 'Brave New World'.

You woke up a few days ago to fulfill the job of your predecessor. Explore a dystopian world from the perspective of a newly arrived member of the government.

[From [url=https://n30hrtgdv.itch.io/visages]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
反乌托邦未来小说大致改编自奥尔德斯·赫胥黎的《美丽新世界》。

几天前你醒来是为了完成前任的工作。从新来的政府成员的角度探索反乌托邦世界。

[来自[url=https://n30hrtgdv.itch.io/visages]Itch.io[/url]]
